verdict.rationale: Tilled offers building blocks for background automation rather than a dedicated automation feature. Subscriptions managed in the Dashboard imply recurring billing that runs on its own [tilled-docs-13]. Webhooks deliver real-time event notifications that a user's own code can act on [tilled-docs-4][tilled-docs-23], and batch closing can be scripted via the API [tilled-docs-35]. Missing for 10: a native automation/workflow builder, scheduling or trigger configuration, explicit autonomous or agentic background execution, and any independent corroboration.
